missing_home.evidence: HOME was present in both the refusing OCI-directory execution and passing archive execution.

missing_docker_configuration_or_authenti.evidence: Docker configuration existed, the credential helper returned an authenticated identity without persisting values, Scout passed its pinned prerequisite gate, and the archive command succeeded.

insufficient_temporary_or_disk_space.evidence: 154798366720 free bytes existed before reproduction and 105395904512 before the committed preflight, both above the 20 GiB floor.

scan_timeout.evidence: The failure occurred in 1.11 seconds against an 1800-second bound; the cold archive scan completed in 216.937 seconds.

image_reference_or_image_corruption.evidence: The export verified the exact bound index, linux/amd64 child, config, attestation, all 21 reachable objects and all 15 child layers; both local tag and local digest scan references passed.

oci_directory_ingestion.evidence: The exact same verified image bytes fail only through oci-dir:// at SBOM generation and pass through archive:// with the exact accepted four-tuple finding set.

root_cause.statement: Docker Scout 1.18.3 reads and indexes the reconstructed OCI directory but cannot generate its SBOM. The exact payload bytes are valid and scan successfully when supplied as a Docker archive.

correction.live_gate: Reconstruct the exact ECR child by digest, verify every descriptor, generate only Docker manifest.json metadata, archive those verified bytes, and scan archive:// with the pinned Scout command.
correction.preflight: A committed $0 real-execution preflight exports and verifies the exact local image and runs the actual archive:// Scout command before any successor attempt.
correction.diagnostics: Every executor external-tool invocation now writes a bounded sanitized journal containing command, exit code or timeout, elapsed time, stdout/stderr byte counts and hashes, and at most 4096 sanitized characters from each stream.
